rows.note: Use this as the all-purpose spoken choice when a result turns out contrary to expectation.

example.english: I thought the rain would cause traffic, but paradoxically I arrived very quickly.
example.traditional: 我本來以為落雨會塞車，反而好快就到咗。
example.jyutping: ngo5 bun2 loi4 ji5 wai4 lok6 jyu5 wui5 sak1 ce1 faan2 ji4 hou2 faai3 zau6 dou3 zo2

rows.note: Use this when the unexpected outcome is especially emphatic, often with a sense of frustration or irony.

example.english: I brought an umbrella, but paradoxically it did not rain at all.
example.traditional: 我帶咗遮，偏偏成日都冇落雨。
example.jyutping: ngo5 daai3 zo2 ze1 pin1 pin1 seng4 jat6 dou1 mou5 lok6 jyu5

rows.note: Use this in formal or written language for the precise abstract sense of creating a paradox.

example.english: Paradoxically, the more restrictions there are, the richer creativity becomes.
example.traditional: 弔詭地，限制越多，創意反而越豐富。
example.jyutping: diu3 gwai2 dei6 haan6 zai3 jyut6 do1 cong3 ji3 faan2 ji4 jyut6 fung1 fu3
